knowledge_gaps: The experiment is reasonable and should precede more complex alternatives. Originality 4/10 is plausible; potential 7/10 is speculative without validation results, and difficulty 2/10 understates reproducibility and diagnostic work.

The treatment equals the uniform control whenever there are at most ten eligible nonterminal targets (history length at most 12). Report the affected-user fraction and actual target-exposure changes per category before expecting a measurable effect.

The treatment consumes additional random draws. A shared RNG can consequently change user sampling, reconstruction masks and other randomness, weakening the claim that only cutoff distribution changes. Use separate deterministic RNG streams for cutoff selection, reconstruction and user sampling.

Specify whether cutoffs are sampled from complete training histories before context truncation, how users and branch examples are sampled, and how histories with fewer than two interactions and empty branches are handled. Explicitly retain identical reconstruction inputs and corruption policy across conditions.

Holding endpoint probability fixed isolates neither context length nor target-item frequency: recent cutoffs change both. Event-order recency also differs from timestamp recency and does not directly encode current intent or unresolved need. Measure these exposure changes using training data.

The report lacks a concrete GPU-budget allocation, checkpoint-selection rule and validation comparison plan. Report paired per-user hit differences and uncertainty on the unchanged validation users/candidates, plus all four category scores; repeated validation selection can overfit this small sample.

Existing margins combine supervised training positions and do not establish terminal-specific difficulty. Compare both conditions on an identical fixed diagnostic set, separating reconstruction, truncated terminal and full-history appended-mask probes. Do not interpret equal loss coefficients as equal gradient contributions.
